raw_text: Production: incompatible changes require a one time migration, documented in the migration guide, automatically run at startup, compartmentalized and easy to remove. Never lose data; Keep and Enhance POSIX/rsync Operational Correctness; Never stall reads; Keep performance as high as possible. Every decision must be made keeping these priorities in mind. Build: `cargo build --release`. Prefer integration tests; use OS commands for filesystem; never test internal API. Run full tests on big changes, focused tests on small changes. Don't test type-system guarantees. VENDOR `vendor/` is our code. Read `docs/technical_deep_dive.md`; `vendor/surrealkv/docs/ARCHITECTURE.md`. DO NOT CREATE NEW TESTS IF YOU ARE NOT EXPLICITLY ASKED TO DO SO. DO NOT PRESERVE BACKWARD COMPATIBILITY IF NOT EXPLICITLY ASKED TO DO SO. DO NOT COMMENT OUT OR KEEP LEGACY CODE IN THE CODEBASE, IF YOU NEED TO CHANGE SOMETHING, CHANGE IT AND REMOVE THE OLD CODE. DO NOT USE PIP, ALWAYS USE UV AND GIVE INSTRUCTIONS ON HOW TO USE IT. DO NOT ADD FALLBACKS. DO NOT WRITE DEFENSIVE CODE.
